owl.text: A barn owl's piercing screech at night, close, eerie, in an African village

hornbill.text: African hornbill deep two-note call echoing across a lagoon at night

stinger1.text: Horror movie jump scare stinger, sharp dissonant string stab with a deep low boom

stinger2.text: Ominous horror whoosh rising into a muted metallic hit, tense

stinger3.text: Short eerie reversed choir swell ending abruptly, horror

heartbeat.text: Slow heavy human heartbeat, close, muffled, steady

night.text: Tropical West African night ambience: crickets, frogs, distant insects, light wind in palm leaves

drone.text: Dark horror ambient drone, low pulsing hum, unsettling, cinematic, no melody

fire.text: Small wood fire crackling and popping at night

whispers.text: Many ghostly voices whispering unintelligibly, layered, distant, horror

ember.text: Hot embers bursting and hissing on impact, short crackle

swing.text: Heavy metal tool swung fast through the air, single whoosh

impact.text: Blunt metal bar hitting a body, dull heavy thud

tire_burst.text: Car tire bursting loudly on a dirt road, then the car skidding and stopping

owl_impact.text: Large bird slamming into a car windshield, heavy thud and glass crack

car_drive.text: Inside an old 4x4 driving slowly on a bumpy dirt road at night, engine rumble

radio.text: Old car radio static and tuning noise between stations

phone_buzz.text: Smartphone vibrating once for a notification, short buzz

generator.text: Old diesel generator sputtering, coughing, then dying

laugh.text: Old woman's slow low laugh in the dark, eerie, distant

breath.text: Raspy ghoulish breathing and a low growl right next to the ear

footsteps.text: Fast bare footsteps running on dry dirt behind you, getting closer

ui_click.text: Short dark horror interface click: a dry wooden knock with a faint breathy whisper tail

ui_hover.text: Very soft eerie low whoosh, like a breath passing by, short

ui_back.text: Short horror interface close sound: low muffled thump with a reversed whisper

gong.text: Deep traditional African gong struck three times at midnight, long echo in the night

kaolin.text: Handful of white powder thrown hard, soft puff and whoosh, dust scattering

explosion.text: Massive fuel depot explosion at night, deep roar, fireball, debris falling, distant screams

festival.text: African village festival at night, talking drums, singing and joyful crowd, slightly distant

tape.text: Old cassette tape inserted into a walkman, play button click, tape hiss

hornbill_far.text: Ground hornbill deep booming two-note call, distant, echoing over a lagoon at night

rite_drums.text: Deep ritual talking drums and slow rattles, hypnotic, West African ceremony at night, loopable

judged.text: Supernatural roaring wind rising into a choir, then a deep rumble as something is dragged underground

souls.text: Soft ethereal rising chime and gentle wind, souls released into light, peaceful
